title: Egyptian Butter Beans Ful Medames
description: A hearty, pungent, and fluffy Ful Medames recipe, made with tender butter beans in a rich, aromatic sauce, served with a side of crusty bread and a dollop of zesty tahini sauce.
instructions: Rinse the soaked butter beans and drain well.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned (8-10 minutes).
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the butter beans, lemon juice, and 1 cup of water to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Season the Ful Medames with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Ful Medames hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley and a dollop of tahini sauce (if using).
Offer crusty bread on the side for dipping into the Ful Medames.
